label: Income tax
description: Effective average rate on household income. Brackets are not indexed, so the effective burden creeps up as incomes rise. (The 1949 top marginal rate was about 82%; the average was far lower.)

label: Corporate tax
description: Rate on corporate profits. Profits swing with the business cycle, and higher rates discourage investment.

label: Excise taxes
description: Taxes on alcohol, tobacco, fuel and luxuries, as a share of consumer spending.

label: Payroll tax
description: Social insurance contributions as a share of wages.

label: Tariffs
description: Average duty on all imports. Higher tariffs cut imports and raise a little revenue.
